verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तौ तु स्वल्पेन कालेन दमघोषेन सङ्गतौ। अथाध्वविधिना तौ तु पञ्चरात्रोषितौ पथि॥१॥
दमघोषेण सङ्गम्य एकरात्रोषिताविव। जग्मतुः सहितौ वीरौ मुदा परमया युतौ। नगरीं मथुरां प्राप्तौ वसुदेवसुतावुभौ॥२॥
verses.english: Improvise some receptacle calling uterus and sconce your brainchildren in there… this apart, neither taking wife nor shedding seed in her is an unsaid rigmarole to ascetics…
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्चचत्वारिंशकेऽस्मिन्प्रोच्यते रामकृष्णयोः। मथुरागमनं चाथ प्रवेशनमहोत्सवः॥१॥ तौ त्विति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रत्युद्गताः सर्वे यादवा यदुनन्दनौ। सबला हृष्टमनस उग्रसेनपुरोगमाः॥३॥
verses.english: Where is a wife, where is lovemaking, where is libidinous thought at all for brahma when he fathered brainchildren just with his volition…

verses.sanskrit: श्रेण्यः प्रकृतयश्चैव मन्त्रिणश्च यथोचिताः। सबालवृद्धा सा चैव पुरी समभिवर्तत॥४॥
verses.english: In that battle दानवा-s have hurled clubs and mountains by hand and assaulted gods including indra to the maximum, without resorting to guiles and tricks, so to speak…

verses.sanskrit: नन्दितूर्याण्यवाद्यन्त स्तूयेतां पुरुषर्षभौ। रथ्यां पताकामालिन्यो भासन्ति स्म समन्ततः॥५॥
verses.english: When the highly powerful दानवा-s with a foreseeable triumph have been battering the gods, the gods have become downhearted and experienced high anguish in that battle …

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टा प्रमुदिता सर्वा पुरी परमशोभिता। भ्रात्रोस्तयोरागमने यथैवेन्द्रमहे तथा॥६॥
verses.english: Roughed up with the fusillades of missiles of demons, skulls of some gods are fractured; chests of some more are gored; some are with many gashes oozing blood; still some more impaled with arrows are shedding blood; some more are put into fetters with nooses, and some more slipping into the stupefaction wizardry – सम्मोहन माय - of दानवा-s are unable to mobilise themselves…

verses.sanskrit: मुदितास्तत्र गायन्ति राजमार्गेषु गायकाः। स्तवाशीर्बहुला गाथा यादवानां प्रियङ्कराः॥७॥
verses.english: What you have recklessly said to me is minus dharma or its meaning, hence all this talk seems to be the prate of prattlers with the genuine…

verses.sanskrit: गोविन्दरामौ सम्प्राप्तौ भ्रातरौ लोकविश्रुतौ। स्वे पुरे निर्भयाः सर्वे क्रीडध्वं यादवाः सुखम्॥८॥
verses.english: This is that insufferable eidolonic inferno, even for gods, is the creation of sage ऊर्व in the days of yore, of course, generated through ritual-fire… fire breeds fire…

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनो वा मलिनो वा विचेतनः। मथुरायामभूत्कश्चिद्रामकृष्णसमागमे॥९॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-fifth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the war of gods and demons.

verses.sanskrit: वयांसि सादुवाक्यानि प्रहृष्टा गोहयद्विपाः। नरनारीगणाश्चैव भेजिरे मानसं सुखम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: I wish you would engender some brainchildren of yours on the lines of brahma’s endeavours, provided you have ascetic efficiency, whereof a feme covert or fatale is inessential…

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्च प्रववुर्वाता विरजस्का दिशो दश। दैवतान्यपि सर्वाणि हृष्यन्त्यायतनेष्वथ॥११॥
verses.english: Demon king हिरण्यकशिपु who is still lingering there, on seeing this wonder worshipped sage ऊर्व prostrating before him, and said this to him:

verses.sanskrit: यानि लिङ्गानि लोकस्य वृत्तानीह कृते युगे। तानि सर्वाण्यदृश्यन्त तयोरागमने तदा॥१२॥
verses.english: Tonsuring heads without ध्यान or योग in those pates, undertaking difficult rituals just for show without any ambition to seek upper worlds, poring over the Absolute minus celibacy – these three are not unlike humbuggery…

verses.sanskrit: ततः काले शिवे पुण्ये स्यन्दनेनारिमर्दनौ। हरियुक्तेन तौ वीरौ प्रविष्टौ मथुरां पुरीम्॥१३॥
verses.english: When those heavenites on battlefield are parched to the extent of dissipating their lustre with the hallucinatory wild-fire, बडबानलम्, devised by demon मय, they immediately rushed to सोम, the moon, who is a lenitive to heat as he lazes most in waters moist with moonbeams, and who is now operating within the precinct of battlefield… and when indra questioned them about their summer-camping under the ambit of moon without battling, they reported to indra about the torrid fire they faced just now..

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशन्तं पुरीं रम्यां गोविन्दं राममेव च। अनुजग्मुर्यदुगणाः शक्रं देवगणा इव॥१४॥
verses.english: On observing the gods roasted by some hallucinatory wild-fire, that too projected by dAnavA-s, indra referred the matter to watergod वरुण, seeking nullification process of that fire, to which वरुण responded in this way:

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवस्य भवनं पितुस्तौ यदुनन्दनौ। प्रविष्टौ हृष्टवदनौ चन्द्रादित्याविवाचलम्॥१५॥
verses.english: In the days of yore, oh, शक्र, an energetic sage named ऊर्व, the son of भृगु, a brahma-sage adorned with accomplishments like those of brahma, undertook sever ascesis...

verses.sanskrit: तत्रायुधानि संन्यस्य गृहे स्वे स्वैरचारिणौ। मुमुदाते यदुवरौ वसुदेवसुतावुभौ॥१६॥
verses.english: When he is scorching whole world with his sever ascesis, like the scorching sun, then other brahma-sages, gods and ascetics have come to him…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु वसुदेवस्य पादौ समभिपीड्य च। तत्रोग्रसेनं राजानमन्यांश्च यदुपुङ्गवान्॥१७॥
verses.english: दानव हिरण्य-कसिपु, the king of dAnavA-s, has also come there as he had an appeal of his own to be made to that highly energetic sage…

verses.sanskrit: यथान्यायं पूजयित्वा तौ सर्वैश्चाभिनन्दितौ। जग्मतुर्हृष्टमनसौ मातुरेव निवेशनम्॥१८॥
verses.english: I doubt that the intensity of this fire has abated with the abatement of हिरण्यकशपु, थे दैत्य, yet alive to counteract our moves… further, it has an undoing too, issued by its creator in the days of yore when he created this from out his power, viz. moon and moonbeams are its counteractants…

verses.sanskrit: एवं तावेकनिर्माणौ मथुरायां शुभाननौ। उग्रसेनानुगौ भूत्वा कञ्चित्कालं मुमोदतुः॥१९॥
verses.english: When the sages have addressed him thus, that self-controlled ascetic ऊर्व is piqued at heart and disapprovingly said this to them:
